wol.title: Power on with native Wake on LAN
wol.description: Select confirmed physical-port MACs and native WOL buttons belonging to this NAS. QTS does not establish physical-port or WOL capability. Disabled or deleted associations require review and remain inactive. You can revisit this setup in Options.

data.create_missing: Review creation of missing WOL entries
data.wol_suggestions_dismissed: Do not suggest again for this NAS

data_description.wol_confirmed_macs: Selected MACs automatically reuse matching WOL buttons. To unlink an interface, deselect its MAC and remove its selected button.
data_description.wol_entities: Additional selection. Removing a button here retains associations selected by MAC.

wol_create.title: Create native WOL entry
wol_create.description: Confirmed MAC {mac}. Review this interface's broadcast and port. Check the confirmation to create it through native Wake on LAN. Leave it unchecked to skip. Entries already created are retained if you cancel a later step.

wol_summary.title: WOL setup result
wol_summary.description: Created {created}. Reused {reused}. Pending or disabled {unavailable}. Unconfigured or skipped {unconfigured}. Save to finish. Power on uses the saved associations when they are available.

power_in_progress.message: A power request is already in progress. Wait for its result before taking another action.

authentication_failed.message: QTS authentication failed. Check the QNAP connection settings. This action was not retried.

permission_denied.message: QTS denied permission for this power action. Monitoring permissions may differ.

power_rejected.message: QTS rejected the power request. Check the account permissions and the NAS status before taking another action.

power_outcome_unknown.message: The power request outcome is unknown. Check the NAS before taking another action. This request was not retried.

power_failed.message: The power request failed. Check the QNAP connection and NAS status before taking another action. This request was not retried.

wake_unavailable.message: Review the WOL associations. A target is missing, disabled or not loaded.

wake_failed.message: The native WOL action failed. Some targets may have received a packet. Check the NAS before pressing again.
